k-sym-JACKET.title: Leather jacket $JACKET coins
k-sym-JACKET.sourceSays: Posts say an account named Yi He posted "I wear a leather jacket. I disagree." on Nov 13; Vietnamese-language posts read it as a nod to Nvidia's Jensen Huang and link a $Jacket pump to it. Unverified.
k-sym-JACKET.reason: Nov 13 posts tie the $Jacket move to a Yi He post and the Jensen Huang leather-jacket meme; interpretation is the posters' own, and most other posts are shills.
